description: One verified competition-solving trajectory. Every record must carry provenance and licensing information; execution results are recorded as measured, never invented.

dataset_provenance.description: Where the underlying data came from and how it was obtained.

dataset_version.description: Version of the dataset this record belongs to, e.g. 'v1'.

errors_and_debugging.description: Errors encountered and the debugging attempts made, in order.

execution_environment.description: Where the code ran, e.g. 'Kaggle notebook, Python 3.10, torch 2.x'.

execution_output.description: Captured stdout/stderr or a summary of the execution result.

final_outcome.description: Final outcome of the trajectory, e.g. 'valid submission, public score 0.81' or 'failed: out of memory'.

generated_code.description: The executable code produced for the trajectory. May be an empty string when the trajectory is analysis-only.

input_schema.description: Input data schema: columns/files, types, and any time column.

license.description: License of the source material, e.g. 'Apache-2.0', 'CC-BY-4.0'.

reasoning_summary.description: Model-generated reasoning or decision summary for the trajectory.

source_url.description: Public URL the trajectory was derived from.

target_definition.description: What is being predicted and how the target is defined.

task_description.description: The competition task in the author's words.

training_validation_strategy.description: How training and validation were split, e.g. 'stratified 5-fold' or 'time-based split'.

validation_score.description: Measured validation score, or null when the trajectory produced no measured score.

title: Akarui competition-solving trajectory record
